verdict.rationale: The docs state you can connect several project folders at once so agents can work across your full stack, and that agents can read, write, and modify files across your workspaces. Each connected workspace also gets a generated WORKSPACE.md that gives the agent high-level project context. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how multiple workspaces are scoped to a single chat session, any limits on how many folders can be connected, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-workspace use.
